blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark-theme crossfilter dashboard with intentional single-hue palette (#4477AA) and clear typographic hierarchy, but 9px network node labels are near-unreadable at rendered size and the dense color-scatter dots vanish where lightness is low against the dark background.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Both node and color bubble sizes use scaleSqrt (area-correct), the histogram baseline is zero with data-driven domain, and color scatter axes use semantically fixed full-range domains [0,360]/[0,100] — no lie factor, no silent gaps, no dual-axis risk.
flags: Update Storm (synchronous O(n) bitFilter computation on every brush mousemove)
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, but both brush handlers synchronously iterate all 34k blocks to recompute bitFilter masks and call bitFilter.filtered() on every mousemove—the computation layer is unbatched even though the render layer is properly throttled.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views stay within working memory limits, no live animation (force layout pre-computed), and a single-hue chrome palette keep load low, but the 60-node network renders as a moderately dense hairball with few visible clusters, making it the one panel where structure is hard to read at a glance.
